definitions.gloss: sailing ship; sailboat; vessel propelled by sails
definitions.explanation: A ship or boat that uses sails to harness wind power for propulsion. Can refer to anything from small sailboats to large historical sailing vessels.

examples.japanese: {帆船|はんせん}が{港|みなと}に{入|はい}った。
examples.english: A sailing ship entered the port.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{帆船|はんせん}の{模型|もけい}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I built a model of a large sailing ship.

examples.japanese: {江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}には{多|おお}くの{帆船|はんせん}が{日本海|にほんかい}を{行|い}き{来|き}していた。
examples.english: In the Edo period, many sailing ships traveled back and forth across the Sea of Japan.

notes:
Composed of {帆|ほ} (sail) + {船|せん} (ship). The reading はんせん uses the on'yomi for both characters. The word {帆|ほ} alone means 'sail' and appears in expressions like {帆|ほ}を{張|は}る (to set sail).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {帆船|はんせん}レース: sailing race
- {帆船|はんせん}の{模型|もけい}: model sailing ship
- {大型|おおがた}{帆船|はんせん}: large sailing vessel
- {帆船|はんせん}{時代|じだい}: age of sail

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ヨット: yacht — modern recreational sailboat
- {汽船|きせん}: steamship — ship powered by steam engine
- {船舶|せんぱく}: vessel — formal general term for ships and boats
